content.text: The fix: initialize best = samples.front(). This handles INT_MIN (no sentinel overflow issues) and negatives.
The bug: `best` is initialized to `0`, so all-negative inputs never exceed it. Initialize from the first sample instead (also safe for the full `int` range, no sentinel).

output.arguments: {"path": "src/stats.cpp", "old": "    int best = 0;\n    for (int value : samples) {", "new": "    int best = samples.front();\n    for (int value : samples) {"}
